cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all existence, often described as the source of all things and the guiding force of nature.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a cosmic order that is beyond human comprehension and cannot be fully expressed in language.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): To express verbally or in writing.
cards.Nuance (English): Often used in the context of communication or discourse.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Speaking is the act of expressing.|What he says can be heard but cannot be seen.|To speak his words, but not perform his deeds.|To speak what he knows, and tell it to others.
cards.Sentences: 道者，言也。|子之道，可闻而不可见。|道其言，而不行其事。|道其所知，以告于人。
